confirmed: Lo/a.Y5 reads tv and uv as per-fief int fields; q.L displays them as 产钱/产粮 with unit 小时, therefore they are final per-hour coin/food output values sent by server.

Lo/a.k1 carries three temporary-state groups: Bv/Cv/Dv for coin output buff, Ev/Fv/Gv for food output buff, Hv/Iv/Jv for building queue buff. Remaining time is stored as current_time + readLong and exposed by q2/J2/V1 helpers.
Static building level effect arrays are En=coin, Fn=food, Gn=population, Hn=recruit queue. Accessors D1/F1/P1/N1 return effect[building][level-1].
The client UI uses server-pushed tv/uv as final display values rather than recomputing exact production totals from buildings at display time.
not_yet_fully_recovered: Exact server-side formula from per-building En/Fn/Gn plus technology/items/buffs/offline time/resource caps is not fully present in the currently traced client path.
Fields vv/wv and Mv/Nv remain partially named and need additional UI/protocol tracing.
Whether tv/uv include active Bv/Ev temporary buffs or show base output while buffs are separately displayed needs live sample comparison.
